name: case_account
comment: Links each loan account to the case it is recovered under.

name: guarantee_claim
comment: A claim against a Thai Credit Guarantee Corporation guarantee or an insurer.

name: partner
comment: An outside firm the bank places work with.

name: case_party
comment: The role each party plays on a case.

name: deviation
comment: A deviation X1 to X7 raised on a case.

name: assignment
comment: Who holds a case or a task and from when.

name: task
comment: A unit of work on a case: a CMMN human, customer, partner or decision task.

name: timer
comment: A running clock on a case: a service level, a legal period or an offer validity.

name: treatment
comment: A resolution put to the customer or carried out on the case, with its terms and outcome.

name: legal_action
comment: A notice, lawsuit, appeal, enforcement or bankruptcy action on a case.

name: notice
comment: A demand, recall or statutory notice and its proof of delivery.

name: hearing
comment: A court hearing on a legal action.

name: debt_sale_account
comment: An account in a debt sale lot.

name: proceeds
comment: Money received on a case and what it was matched to.

name: partner_instruction
comment: Work placed with a partner on a case.

name: document_custody
comment: Each movement of an original document.

name: document
comment: A document held against a case.

name: rule_row
comment: One versioned routing rule or sentry.

name: decision_log_entry
comment: One record per decision. Append only and hash chained.

name: listing
comment: An asset offered for sale, with its prices and rounds.

name: debt_sale_lot
comment: A lot of accounts offered to debt buyers.

name: interaction
comment: One entry in the interaction ledger: a contact, letter, promise, payment or hand-over.

name: document_field
comment: A field read from a document.

name: write_off
comment: A write-off of the balance on a case.

name: lov_value
comment: A value in a list of values.

name: role
comment: A Workbench role, held as data.

name: delegation_limit
comment: An approval limit by decision, level, product and amount.

name: data_product_access
comment: Which role may read which data product, by version.

name: data_product_load
comment: The freshness stamp of a data product for one business date.

name: data_contract
comment: A versioned data contract with one source system, confirmed by its system owner.

name: data_product
comment: One of the 14 data products, with its single system of record, owner and refresh cycle.

name: template
comment: A letter or notice template.

name: sys_objects
comment: The metadata registry of entities: one row per object in the data dictionary.

name: sys_fields
comment: The metadata registry of fields: the data dictionary held as data.

name: sys_field_version
comment: Each version of a field definition, kept when the definition changes.

name: retention_rule
comment: How long rows of a table or a retention class are kept and what happens at the end, by version.

name: reconciliation_result
comment: The daily reconciliation of the case list to ALS by product group.

name: lake_copy_watermark
comment: How far a copy to the data lake has reached, for example the decision log copy.

name: interface_config
comment: The settings of one file interface, by version.

name: case_list_row
comment: One row of the daily case list per case account and business date, published to Power BI.

name: idempotency_key
comment: The stored response of an API request sent with an Idempotency-Key header, kept 24 hours.

name: outbound_item
comment: One outbound file waiting to be sent, sent or in the exception queue.

name: dp_treatment
comment: The copy of each treatment for a business date in the DP04 data product.

name: dp_guarantee_claim
comment: The copy of each guarantee claim for a business date in the DP04 data product.

name: processed_event
comment: An event or work key a consumer has already processed, so a repeat is ignored and counted.

name: feature_flag
comment: A feature flag with its value per environment, owner and removal date.

name: feature_flag_change
comment: One change of a feature flag value in one environment.

name: job_catalog
comment: A scheduled job with its owner, run book and expected duration.

name: efs_ledger_outcome
comment: Which EFS action codes enter the interaction ledger and on which channel.

name: case_entry_exclusion
comment: An account at 90 days past due that an exclusion rule kept out of recovery on a business date.

name: parameter_catalog
comment: The definition of every parameter and environment setting, with its owner and default.

name: parameter_value
comment: An approved, dated value version of a parameter per environment and product group.

name: outbox_event
comment: An application event or outbound work request written in the same transaction as the change.

name: reference_version
comment: One version of a reference or rule table, with its author, approver, checks and change checklist.

name: outbox_delivery
comment: The delivery of one outbox event to one consumer, with its retries.

name: queue_member
comment: A person who works a queue, with personal capacity and skills, by version.

name: queue_measure
comment: One snapshot of a queue's counts, ageing and breaches, published when it reconciles to the case list.

name: partner_user
comment: A partner user's identity bound to one partner firm and one partner role.

name: rule_test_case
comment: A test case of the rule table test harness, with its expected and actual result.

name: masking_rule
comment: Which role sees which personal data field unmasked, by version.

name: role_conflict
comment: A pair of roles one person may not hold together, by version.

name: document_checklist_item
comment: A document type required or expected for a case stage and route, by checklist version.

name: document_hub_parameter
comment: A document hub parameter value, by version.

name: document_text
comment: The OCR text of one page of an intake item.

name: retention_action
comment: What the monthly retention job did with one document.

name: document_type
comment: A document type, the fields extracted from it and its Legal and NPA sign-off, by version.

name: case_document_check
comment: The latest document completeness check of a case against its checklist.

name: document_intake
comment: A file received by the document hub, from scan to OCR, classification, extraction, matching and review.

name: merge_field
comment: A merge code a template may use and the field that supplies its value, by catalog version.

name: agent_policy
comment: A version of an agent's policy: model, tools, autonomy, limits and fallback.

name: payment_match_rule
comment: A rule for matching a payment to a plan installment, by version.

name: measure_definition
comment: The agreed definition of a reported measure, by version.

name: measure_snapshot
comment: The value of one measure for a business date, product and dimension value.

name: measure_publish
comment: Whether the day's dashboard data set was published or held after reconciling to the case list.

name: agent_run
comment: One call of an agent or model, with its versions, checks, answer, cost and fallback.

name: agent_prompt
comment: A version of an agent's prompt text.

name: agent_sample
comment: One labeled subject in a versioned evaluation sample.

name: signature_request
comment: A request for a party to sign a generated document, and its result.

name: approval
comment: An item waiting for approval, routed to the level the delegation of authority requires.

name: agent_alert
comment: A cost cap or drift alert raised for an agent.

name: v_data_dictionary
comment: The data dictionary as one row per field, with its data product, refresh cycle and owner.

name: queue
comment: A queue of work belonging to one team and one role.

name: recovery_case
comment: One recovery case per customer per product, from 90 days past due to close.

name: asset_sale
comment: The sale of an asset.

name: permission
comment: What a role may do in one capability area.

name: reference_row
comment: One row of a reference table version held as data.

name: agent_evaluation_run
comment: One evaluation of an agent version against a sample.

name: agent_evaluation
comment: The score of one approach on one label key in an evaluation run.

name: agent_feedback
comment: A person's verdict on an agent answer.

name: v_ace_account
comment: ACE account as the Workbench reads it. delay_days maps to days_past_due; core_banking_system_date is the data_as_of.

name: v_ace_payment
comment: ACE payment as the Workbench reads it. pay_date is varchar in ACE, cast to date by ace_to_date.

name: v_ace_customer
comment: ACE customer as the Workbench reads it. identification_number is masked in the view; the clear value is never exposed.

name: v_ace_contact
comment: ACE phone, email and address as one contact-point view. contact_value is the full value notices and calls need; contact_value_masked is for display (E1-037).

name: v_ace_ca_relation
comment: ACE customer-account relation: who is borrower, guarantor or co-borrower on which account.

name: v_ace_aa_relation
comment: ACE account-account relation, used to group a facility with its sub-accounts.

name: v_ace_collateral
comment: ACE collateral and the asset behind it. One row per account-collateral-asset link.

name: v_ace_asset
comment: ACE asset as the Workbench reads it, for collateral and for a held asset.

name: v_ace_efs_action
comment: ACE EFS action log. Replaces the collections_history copy; action_timestamp maps to contact_at.

name: v_ace_efs_action_code
comment: ACE EFS action code reference. The loaded LIST-ACTION-CODE list (1,106 values) reads this.

name: v_ace_efs_assignment
comment: ACE assignment history, used for hand-over and agency performance.

name: v_ace_bucket_log
comment: ACE monthly bucket snapshot, keyed by account_key. bucket is the month-end bucket, not the daily bucket.

name: v_ace_product
comment: ACE product reference, used for the product and product group lists of values.

name: v_ace_branch
comment: ACE branch reference, used for the branch and region lists of values.

name: v_ace_holiday
comment: ACE Bank of Thailand holiday calendar. E1-043 and E1-045 read this instead of a Workbench list.

name: v_ace_plan
comment: ACE restructure case, its TDR calculation and the top-ranked recommended plan. Replaces the plan fields the Workbench used to copy.

name: v_ace_batch_status
comment: Per-source ACE batch completion and business date. The Workbench freshness stamp (E1-015) reads this.

name: v_ace_valuation
comment: SVAF appraisal as ingested into ACE. Accepted, stale and valuer fields stay in recovery.valuation_ext.

name: v_ace_collateral_detail
comment: CCMS collateral detail as ingested into ACE: title deed, plot, area, location, insurance and lien rank.

name: v_ace_npa_asset
comment: NPA asset from AMIS (property) and RPS (vehicles), as ingested into ACE.

name: v_ace_npa_sale
comment: NPA sale contract and its taxes and fees, from AMIS, as ingested into ACE.

name: v_ace_lawsuit
comment: LIT lawsuit as ingested into ACE: case numbers, court, claim, judgment and status.

name: v_ace_hearing
comment: LIT court hearing as ingested into ACE.

name: v_ace_pod
comment: WIN proof of delivery as ingested into ACE. The notice itself stays in recovery.notice.

name: v_ace_write_off
comment: GL write-off posting as ingested into ACE. The write-off decision stays in recovery.write_off.

name: v_ace_score
comment: COLLINS score and route estimate as ingested into ACE, if ACE does not already hold it.

name: v_ace_party_product
comment: SCBPDM customer product holding as ingested into ACE. Replaces the Workbench party_product copy.

name: v_ace_credit_decision
comment: NLEADS credit approval as ingested into ACE. Replaces the four credit fields the Workbench used to record by hand.

name: v_ace_esign
comment: EasyApp signature request as ingested into ACE. The Workbench document still owns the signed file.

name: v_ace_iam_group
comment: Entra ID group to Workbench role mapping as ingested into ACE. ACE performs the sign-in, so it owns the mapping.
